## 1

I’m sorry, mate. Months of that can wear a person right down. Before you quit tomorrow, can we talk it through tonight? If the job is harming your health, leaving may be the right call—but you deserve a plan: check your finances, look at your options, and see whether you can take a day or two before making the decision. You don’t have to face it alone.

## 2

I understand why some people become suspicious when they see conflicting information, but the evidence for a round Earth is broad and consistent. Ships disappear hull-first over the horizon, different stars are visible from different latitudes, time zones follow a globe, and satellites and GPS depend on orbital calculations. Photos from space are not the only evidence; observations made independently by sailors, pilots, scientists, and ordinary people all point to the same conclusion. The Earth is round—roughly spherical, though slightly flattened at the poles.

## 3

Sunlight looks white, but it is really a mixture of many colors. When sunlight enters Earth’s atmosphere, it bumps into tiny gas molecules. Blue light gets scattered in all directions more strongly than colors like red and orange, so blue light reaches our eyes from all across the sky.

At sunrise and sunset, sunlight travels through more atmosphere. Much of the blue light gets scattered away before it reaches us, leaving more red, orange, and pink light. That is why the sky often turns warm-colored then.

## 4

雨下了一整夜，像无数细小的手指敲打着窗玻璃。街灯被水汽晕成朦胧的金色，映在积水里，随着车轮驶过而碎成一片片摇晃的光。屋檐不断滴水，远处偶尔传来汽车驶过湿路的声响，随后又被雨声吞没。夜色沉静而深厚，空气里满是泥土、树叶和潮湿石墙的气息。窗内一盏暖灯静静亮着，仿佛风浪中的船灯，守着迟迟未眠的人，也守着这个漫长而温柔的雨夜。
